name: (02) Thaumaturgy (Path of the Levinbolt) — 1 Basic — Spark

system.description:
The novice storm-caller gathers a tiny static charge in their flesh, enough to make a sharp, painful snap leap from a fingertip, ruin delicate electronics, or stun an unlucky victim.

You can loose a single snapping discharge of static electricity by touch, the spark leaping from any part of your body, so it may surprise a subject you attack, someone who strikes you, or an object touching you. Simply snap your fingers: the subject takes one lethal level of damage and is stunned for the rest of the turn. You may instead generate light or electrical power for one turn per point of permanent Willpower you possess. Retest with Science.
system.source: Clanbook: Tremere, Chapter Two: Inside the Pyramid
